title: Real-Time Bidding Bid Optimisation

blueprintSignals.name: Calibrated pCVR
blueprintSignals.definition: predicted conversion probability after isotonic calibration

blueprintSignals.name: Win-rate curve
blueprintSignals.definition: win probability as a function of bid for the segment
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Censored data below the observed bids

blueprintSignals.name: Pacing multiplier
blueprintSignals.definition: budget remaining relative to the ideal pacing curve

blueprintSignals.name: Clearing-price density
blueprintSignals.definition: survival regression on won and lost bids per exchange and segment
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Lost bids are right-censored, so fitting on won bids only makes the price look too high

blueprintSignals.name: In-flight spend reserve
blueprintSignals.definition: sum of submitted bids whose win notice (burl) has not arrived
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Counting only billed wins lets a traffic spike overspend the budget

label: For "Real-Time Bidding Bid Optimisation": Compute the bid for every impression opportunity that maximises campaign value under budget and KPI constraints within the auction deadline. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Training only on won impressions ignores the censored losing bids.
